scout_tight_bidask_retrace.name: Scout Tight Bid-Ask Retrace
scout_tight_bidask_retrace.author: meridian-phase2a

token_criteria.notes: Scout-only tight-bin evidence strategy for high-fee, high-volume retrace or runner pools. Keep filters quality-biased; do not loosen screening to compensate for tighter bins.

entry.condition: Deploy SOL-only into a tight bid_ask range below active price after candidate passes current scout screening.
entry.notes: Use amount_y only, amount_x=0. The upper bin is pinned to active price with bins_above=0.

range.notes: Tight single-sided SOL range for the OOR-reposition scout trial. No volatility expansion unless a future strategy JSON explicitly defines it.

exit.notes: OOR-above may close and reposition only after fresh same-pool/base-mint screening passes. OOR-below is adverse/rug-risk and must not reposition.

scout_tight_bidask_retrace.best_for: Phase 2A scout evidence: tight bid_ask fee-density and OOR-above reposition behavior on higher-flow pools.
scout_tight_bidask_retrace.raw: Owner-approved scout tight-bin strategy-library profile; strategy-specific numbers live in JSON/config, not generic deploy code.
